purpose: Make the next evaluation challenging through verifiable work, not arbitrary penalties. Do not rescore old answers against new requirements.
design: Three fixture families per task: complete baseline, forensic boundary case, and paired robustness case. Use private date/entity variants after development.
Two data-access tracks: identical provided evidence packets for reasoning; native/open-web retrieval as a separate product task. Paper execution gets its own isolated simulator/state oracle.
Freeze exact input/source/rubric hashes, choices, budgets, planned trials and retry rules before launch. Record first valid submission; technical retry does not erase genuine failure.
For declared discretionary methods, score defensibility against evidence; for deterministic subtasks, compute exact reference answers independently.
Pilot with strong reference systems and qualified analysts. A ceiling signals a need for more demanding development fixtures; never forbid a legitimately perfect score on frozen tests.
Unknown evaluator truth is missing benchmark coverage, not evidence of difficulty. Publish both error rates and source-validation coverage.

Use paired task-level comparisons only after validation, cluster uncertainty by task/fixture, report per-template results and multiplicity-aware comparisons; do not treat correlated criteria or judges as independent samples.
Add paper lifecycle fixtures for isolated buying power, shared-account stop, partial fills, cancellation receipts, timed shutdown and inactive future policy. No live brokerage required.

tasks.name: Company-level market cap
tasks.challenge: Reconcile share classes, point-in-time membership, competing leaders and synchronized closing values.
tasks.next_difficulty_case: Add close-date changes, conflicting share-count vintages and an exact-tie fixture.

tasks.name: Twenty-manager consensus
tasks.challenge: Rebuild twenty top-ten lists from the correct 13F filings; deduplicate managers, instruments and voting counts.
tasks.next_difficulty_case: Supply amendment/addition fixtures, option rows, dollar-unit changes and share-class collisions.

tasks.name: Congress disclosure trigger
tasks.challenge: Use public disclosure time, distinct member identities and transaction-range lower bounds.
tasks.next_difficulty_case: Use delayed filings, multiple owners for one member, $499,999/$500,000 boundaries and an untriggered control.

tasks.name: Insider clusters
tasks.challenge: Verify membership and distinct CEO/CFO plus director open-market buyers using footnotes.
tasks.next_difficulty_case: Add a dual-role person, 10b5-1 exclusion, grant/exercise distractors and late public filings.

tasks.name: Estimate revisions
tasks.challenge: Reconstruct historical strength, breadth and momentum with the declared score and data vintage.
tasks.next_difficulty_case: Supply complete archived endpoints plus missing-data, revised-after-cutoff and near-tie variants.

tasks.name: Oligopoly quality
tasks.challenge: Match concentration and leadership to one market definition; reconcile ROIC, cash flow and pricing power.
tasks.next_difficulty_case: Provide conflicting geography/market boundaries, one-off cash flow and negative counterevidence.

tasks.name: AI bottlenecks
tasks.challenge: Compare five constraints, establish which actually binds, then connect three firms to cash flow.
tasks.next_difficulty_case: Contrast capacity constraints with demand growth, indirect exposure and bottleneck rotation.

tasks.name: Lobbying to revenue
tasks.challenge: Deduplicate entities, rank comparable growth first, then confirm the top five without backfilling.
tasks.next_difficulty_case: Include zero/tiny denominators, duplicate subsidiaries, a failed top-five confirmation and tempting sixth name.

tasks.name: Four-regime rotation
tasks.challenge: Rebuild release-vintage signs, tie/zero handling, exact ETF maps and initialization.
tasks.next_difficulty_case: Exercise every regime, cutoff-overlap ambiguity, revisions and missing incumbent state.

tasks.name: Public robo-model policy
tasks.challenge: Separate supplied assumptions from approved disclosures; apply exact weights, cash triggers and fees.
tasks.next_difficulty_case: Test strict versus inclusive boundaries, missing instrument approval, cash versus target and stale model versions.

tasks.name: Earnings-mention PageRank
tasks.challenge: Build a complete source-bound directed graph and independently verify scores with isolates and dangling nodes.
tasks.next_difficulty_case: Test edge reversal, duplicate/self/subsidiary mentions, isolates, dangling mass and false toy-to-full claims.
